Gitboard serves as a local code-change dashboard for GitLab and GitHub, providing developers with a centralized view of CI status, open Merge Requests, and failed job triage. By integrating with `gh`, `glab`, and `git`, it synchronizes remote forge activity with local worktree state to streamline the transition between reviewing remote changes and local development.
